newsArticles.title: Annual Harvest Festival & Pongal Celebrations
newsArticles.author: St. Joseph Principal's Desk
newsArticles.summary: Special cultural assembly celebrating traditional harvest traditions, folk dances, and community harmony.
newsArticles.body: St. Joseph English High School organized a vibrant cultural assembly to celebrate the traditional harvest festival. Students participated in traditional rangoli making, classical music performances, and shared sweet pongal treats.

newsArticles.title: 78th Independence Day & Grand March-Past Parade Celebrated with Patriotic Fervor
newsArticles.kannadaTitle: 78ನೇ ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯ ದಿನಾಚರಣೆ ಮತ್ತು ಭವ್ಯ ಪಥಸಂಚಲನ ಸಂಭ್ರಮಾಚರಣೆ
newsArticles.author: Physical Education & Cultural Desk
newsArticles.summary: Students and faculty gathered in the school quadrangle for the unfurling of the National Tri-color, vibrant inter-house drill formations, and student address on constitutional values.
newsArticles.body: The 78th Independence Day was commemorated with solemn pride and vibrant spirit at St. Joseph English High School. The National Flag was hoisted by Principal Sr. Arockia Vinotha CIC, followed by the National Anthem rendered by the school choir. All four houses demonstrated precision drill marching, patriotic cultural songs, and classical dance tributes. Students took a solemn pledge towards environmental stewardship and secular national brotherhood.

newsArticles.title: International Yoga Day: Mass Quadrangle Demonstration & Mindful Living Workshop
newsArticles.kannadaTitle: ಅಂತರರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಯೋಗ ದಿನ: ಸಾಮೂಹಿಕ ಯೋಗ ಪ್ರದರ್ಶನ
newsArticles.author: Health & Physical Education Cell
newsArticles.summary: Over 850 students from Primary to High School performed synchronized Suryanamaskar, Pranayama breathing exercises, and meditation under certified yoga instructors.
newsArticles.body: In alignment with the CBSE Health & Physical Education mandate, St. Joseph English High School celebrated International Yoga Day in the main open quadrangle. Students engaged in structured Asanas designed to boost concentration, flexibility, and emotional balance. Sr. Principal highlighted the timeless value of inner discipline and daily mindfulness for academic excellence.

newsArticles.title: CBSE Class 10 Board Examinations 2026: 100% Pass Percentage with 58 Distinctions
newsArticles.author: Office of the Principal
newsArticles.summary: All 142 registered Class 10 students cleared the Central Board examinations with flying colors, continuing St. Joseph's multi-decade legacy of 100% academic results.
newsArticles.body: St. Joseph English High School records another historic milestone with a 100% pass result in the Class X CBSE Board Exams 2026. 58 students secured above 90% aggregate scores with top distinctions in Mathematics, Science, and Kannada. The Management, Sisters of CIC, and teachers congratulate all students and supportive parents for their tireless dedication.

newsArticles.title: Annual Science & Composite Lab Experiential Learning Exhibition Inaugurated
newsArticles.kannadaTitle: ವಾರ್ಷಿಕ ವಿಜ್ಞಾನ ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರಾಯೋಗಿಕ ಕಲಿಕಾ ಪ್ರದರ್ಶನ
newsArticles.author: Department of Science & Innovation
newsArticles.summary: Middle and High school students showcased working models on renewable hydro-power, smart eco-farming, organic chemistry crystallization, and optics.
newsArticles.body: The Annual Science Innovation Expo transformed the school's composite laboratories into an interactive science hub. Students demonstrated practical hypotheses, robotic sensor circuits, and biological cell models before an esteemed jury of visiting educationists.

newsArticles.title: Official Circular: Admissions Open for Academic Year 2026-27 & RTE Quota Allocations
newsArticles.kannadaTitle: 2026-27 ಶೈಕ್ಷಣಿಕ ವರ್ಷದ ಪ್ರವೇಶಾತಿ ಮತ್ತು RTE ಮೀಸಲಾತಿ ಸುತ್ತೋಲೆ
newsArticles.author: Admissions Secretariat
newsArticles.summary: Online applications and offline registration desks are now active for Pre-Nursery through Class IX. Parents can track application status online.
newsArticles.body: The Admission Committee of St. Joseph English High School announces the commencement of the 2026-27 admissions cycle. 25% quota seats under the Right to Education (RTE) Act are open for eligible candidates as per Govt of Karnataka directives. Parents are encouraged to submit documents online or at the school reception desk.
